title: Test A assignment with rubric table

items.title: Test A: Truss analysis
items.description:
Solve the truss on the worksheet and show a free body diagram for each joint.

- Label each member T (tension) or C (compression).
- Check your answer with the sum of forces at one joint.

The rubric below shows how this is scored.

criteria.title: Free body diagrams
criteria.description: Every joint has a correct diagram.

criteria.title: Member forces
criteria.description: Forces are solved and labeled T or C.

criteria.title: Check
criteria.description: Answer is checked at one joint.
